sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm: proposed reciprocal trade for 2027–2028
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal trade.

Delivery: we can accept your quoted 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1), giving your planning more room.

Commitment: your capacity letter of 18 September 2026 (doc:20260918-70410-P10) prioritises firm, long-term commitments. In line with that, we offer a binding 23,400 pcs in each year for 24 months.

In return, we ask for full allocation of that volume at EUR 29.89/unit, DAP, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, with no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm: proposed reciprocal trade for 2027–2028
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. However, your theoretical cost estimate does not reflect our production realities, making your target price unachievable. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. 

We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month contract at 23,400 pieces per year. In recognition of the extended commitment, we offer a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Which volume can you commit to? 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Legal Department: Please be advised that our general terms and conditions apply exclusively, and the quote lists our standard terms.

sup:70410.subject: Seal 24 mm – 36-month full-volume package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for moving to full allocation. To answer your question: we can commit to a binding 23,400 pcs in each contract year.

We propose to extend that commitment to 36 months. Our package: EUR 31.07/unit, 23,400 pcs/year binding in each year, 36 months, 54-day lead time, DAP, payment 30 days net, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

This means we move from EUR 29.89 to EUR 31.07/unit and add a third committed year. We also continue to accept 54 days rather than the 42-day standard recorded in our framework agreement. We ask you to recognise that combined commitment in the complete price.

EUR 31.07 is our commercial proposal for this exchange, supported by the buyer estimate we shared earlier. It is not based on any disclosed cost of yours.

Could you confirm this package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70410.subject: Re: Seal 24 mm – 36-month full-volume package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your proposal to extend the contract term to 36 months at a volume of 23,400 pieces per year. 

In return for this extended commitment, we offer a revised price of EUR 31.40 per unit. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

For complete clarity, our offer comprises a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. We await your confirmation of this offer.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
